sections.text: Controls and Indications on The Front Panel

A green LED on 
the front panel indicates that the module is working.

It remains on if 
the module is operating correctly and goes off in case of faulty operation 
(fault detected in the configuration, hardware or use of the module).
Output Elements

The module includes 16 
logic outputs built from monostable relays with make contacts. Each relay 
winding is energized by two transistors, one providing the +12V voltage and the 
other the 0V. The controls of these transistors are separated and complemented.

The risk of an untimely 
output is thus very low.
A protection against overloads is connected in series with each contact.
Process Voltage

The process 
voltage is supplied by the backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the 
process connector (external voltage).

A logic 
input based on an opto-isolator indicates the presence of the process voltage.
حماية

General protection on the 
process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum tripping current at 20C: 0.45 A.
